source: Sasini Plc audited consolidated statement of profit or loss for the year ended 30 September 2025
source_note: FY2025 Operating Profit (EBIT) is the statement line "Results from operations" (KShs 407,616 thousand); Operating Expenses = Gross profit less that line. FY2025 Net finance cost 63,589 and income tax expense 166,706 are the printed lines. FY2024 and FY2023 EBIT/Operating Expenses are derived from this file's own stored rows (gross profit + fair value changes + other income + impairment - administration - selling), because the FY2025 report restated the FY2024 comparatives on a different basis (revenue 6,836,470 vs 6,893,826 stored). PBT less income tax equals profit from continuing operations (177,321); profit for the year (188,008) also carries the discontinued operations line of 10,687. All figures KES thousands. UNIT APPLIED: figures converted x1000 from the unit stated in the filing (e.g. Kshs '000). Conversion only where the result reconciles with the annual column.
